lines.text: Neco king of Egypt marched up to fight at Carchemish by the Euphrates, and Josiah went out to confront him.
Neco sent messengers saying he was fighting another dynasty and God had told him to wait.
Josiah disguised himself and went to fight Neco on the Plain of Megiddo, where archers shot him.
Josiah's servants put him in his second chariot and brought him to Samaria, where he died.
Jeremiah lamented over Josiah, and the laments are written in the Book of Laments.
